subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Identificar e respeitar acontecimentos sagrados de diferentes culturas e tradições religiosas como recurso para preservar a memória.

components.description_pt: Identificar eventos sagrados de diferentes culturas e tradições religiosas
components.description_en: Identify sacred events from different cultures and religious traditions
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

components.description_pt: Explicar como eventos sagrados contribuem para preservar a memória religiosa coletiva
components.description_en: Explain how sacred events contribute to preserving collective religious memory

components.description_pt: Demonstrar respeito a eventos sagrados de tradições religiosas diferentes da própria
components.description_en: Demonstrate respect toward sacred events from religious traditions other than one's own
components.cc_component_description: Respond thoughtfully to perspectives that differ from one's own during discussion

cc_matches.description: Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.

Respond thoughtfully to diverse perspectives, summarize points of agreement and disagreement, and, when warranted, qualify or justify their own views and understanding and make new connections in light of the evidence and reasoning presented.
